Market today: Tech and chip names are seeing a mixed but generally positive mood. Strong cloud growth and Microsoft earnings are driving optimism, with some betting the AI trade has bottomed. This is good news for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SMH is already below its stop at 540, needing immediate attention. SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-57.93%) are leveraged and deeply in the red; their stops are far from current prices, which is extra painful on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on follow-through in chip stocks after Microsoft's boost. Also, monitor broader tech sentiment for any signs of Meta's struggles spreading.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged and breached positions while selectively looking for strength in core tech.
plays: Trim or exit SMH (current 538.9) as it's breached your 540 stop, managing the -15.32% loss.
Re-evaluate stops for SOXL and SPAL, both down over 50% and leveraged; their current stops are too far from price.
Consider a new buy on MSFT (scanner entry 450.65-450.2, stop 449.52) given strong earnings boosting chip stocks.
